name: Clackmannanshire
title: Clackmannanshire —
tagline: Scotland's smallest mainland council area, with the Ochil Hills on its doorstep.
summary: Clackmannanshire is known as the Wee County. It sits on the north side of the Forth beneath the Ochil Hills, with Alloa as its main town.
Alloa Tower and Castle Campbell above Dollar Glen are the stars, and the old brewing and glass industries shaped local life.

community.intro: The Wee County has a strong sense of community, and its people have settled all over the world.
